title: General defences may defeat or limit an otherwise established tort

content.study:
General defences may defeat or limit an otherwise established tort. Volenti, inevitable accident, act of God and necessity are distinct doctrines with different ingredients.\
\
The common law recognises circumstances where conduct is consented to, unavoidable, justified by extraordinary natural forces, or necessary to avert a greater danger. Volenti requires informed and voluntary assumption of risk; mere knowledge is not automatically consent. Necessity is narrowly framed and ordinarily requires proportionality.
